one_line: Legendary Chandel warrior of Mahoba, set against the real Prithviraj–Paramardi conflict in late 12th‑century Bundelkhand.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, compact and powerful build, about 5'7" with broad shoulders and battle-hardened posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Bundelkhand complexion, straight nose, thick brows, a faint horizontal scar on the left cheek, and a focused, calm default expression that sharpens with quiet determination.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied into a high warrior topknot at the crown, sides and back neatly trimmed; a narrow maroon cloth headband wraps the forehead under a plain, slightly pointed steel helmet with a small nasal bar and no plume.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton angarkha tied to the right, he wears a fitted riveted steel mail shirt reaching mid-thigh with short sleeves, over which sits a simple round iron breastplate; a deep forest-green cotton patka sash is wrapped twice around his waist, knotted on the left with its ends hanging; below, he wears straight, slightly tapered dark indigo cotton churidar-style trousers and sturdy brown leather boots reaching mid-calf; his forearms are protected by plain iron bracers over the angarkha sleeves; a muted maroon woollen shawl/uttariya is slung from his left shoulder across his back like a short cloak, practical and unornamented, and small iron stud earrings and a simple black-thread amulet at his neck complete the look.
appearance.signature: A broad, slightly curved single-edged Bundelkhandi talwar with a simple iron hilt, disc pommel and no ornate inlay, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard at his left hip, which he often rests his right hand upon.

ref_desc: Alha is a late-20s, medium-brown Bundelkhand warrior with a scarred left cheek, black hair in a high topknot under a plain steel helmet and maroon headband, wearing off-white angarkha, steel mail and breastplate, forest-green sash, dark indigo trousers, maroon shawl, brown boots, iron bracers and earrings, and carrying a simple steel talwar in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Alha, a late-12th-century Bundelkhand warrior: a late-20s, compact, broad-shouldered man with medium-brown complexion, oval face, strong jaw, straight nose, thick brows, and a faint horizontal scar on his left cheek, his default expression calm and quietly determined. His thick black hair is tied into a high topknot at the crown, sides and back neat, wrapped with a narrow maroon cloth headband, all under a plain, slightly pointed steel helmet with a small nasal bar and no plume. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton angarkha tied to the right, covered by a fitted riveted steel mail shirt to mid-thigh with short sleeves and a simple round iron breastplate. Around his waist is a deep forest-green cotton patka sash wrapped twice, knotted on the left with its ends hanging. His trousers are straight, slightly tapered dark indigo cotton churidar-style pants, tucked into sturdy brown leather boots reaching mid-calf. His forearms have plain iron bracers strapped over the angarkha sleeves, and a muted maroon woollen shawl/uttariya is slung from his left shoulder across his back like a short cloak. Add small iron stud earrings and a simple black-thread amulet at his neck. His signature weapon is a broad, slightly curved single-edged Bundelkhandi steel talwar with a simple iron hilt and disc pommel, carried in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard at his left hip, which he lightly grips with his right hand. Use a grounded palette of forest green, maroon, off-white, dark indigo, steel grey and brown leather, and show him from multiple angles to clearly display face, hair, armour, clothing, and sword details.
